/star-citizen-player-count.claim: Star Citizen crossed $1 billion in total funding raised on May 24, 2026, from over 6.5 million backer accounts.

Star Citizen is available only for Windows PC through the RSI Launcher, purchased directly from robertsspaceindustries.com — it is not sold on Steam, Epic, or GOG, and does not run on PlayStation, Xbox, or Game Pass (as of October 2026). Squadron 42, CIG's separate single-player game, does have a Steam page (wishlist only).

CIG does not publish active-player or concurrent-player statistics for Star Citizen. The official RSI funding tracker reports total registered accounts ('Star Citizens', 6.5M+ as of mid-2026) — an all-time account count, not an active-player number. All specific 'player count' figures on third-party sites are estimates.

Squadron 42 has an official Steam store page (app 4045720, published by Roberts Space Industries, developed by Cloud Imperium Games) that went live on October 10, 2026; it can be wishlisted but not bought, lists a planned release of Q2 2027, Windows only, and notes support for linking a Roberts Space Industries account to a Steam account.
